title: fix(ui): remove duplicate Ask OpenClaw toolbar button
body:
## What Problem This Solves

The collapsed sidebar toolbar still showed a separate **Ask OpenClaw** button even though that conversation is already available in the **Home** dock.

## Why This Change Was Made

Remove the duplicate launcher and simplify its rendering helper to the single Home entry point. Keep the existing Home button and its access rules, and remove the extra reserved toolbar width so Inbox sits next to Home. Update the existing toolbar/layout fixtures and the panel guide.

## User Impact

The collapsed toolbar is shorter. Open **Home → Ask OpenClaw** for system setup and repair; Settings and the command palette continue to provide their existing entry points.

## Evidence

- Existing shell test fails against the original button and passes with its removal.
- All 20 focused tests pass across shell dock suppression, Inbox browser layout, expanded-panel toolbar clearance, and the mocked-Gateway assistant flow. The latter covers Home → Ask OpenClaw, command-palette access, history, and persisted session reuse.
- Verified the toolbar and Home → Ask OpenClaw in real Chrome against the isolated synthetic mock Gateway.
- Independent Codex reviews: no actionable findings through P2, including the updated Home capability fixture.
- All changed-file checks pass. [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34769750288) passed, including the real-Gateway UI suite. ClawSweeper completed with no actionable findings.
